name: Mandarin
title: Mandarin Role-play
about: Practise speaking Mandarin with a partner. You get a prompt in English, say it out loud in Mandarin, then tap to see one way to say it (characters with pinyin).
how: Pick a scene and a role. Your partner plays the other part and reads their lines from the screen (the pinyin helps). No partner? Read their lines yourself.
When it's your turn, read the prompt and say your line out loud before you tap. A guess is fine: that's the practice.
Then compare. Close enough counts: if your partner understood you, tap Got it. Watch the tones.
Play each scene as both roles for two stars. Get every line right first time for the third.

levels.title: Level 2
levels.note: I like, I have, describe it

scenes.title: Making a new friend
scenes.setting: You're on holiday in Beijing and meet someone your age at the park.
scenes.tip: Swap in your own name and age once you know the script. 你呢？ (and you?) bounces any question back.

lines.cue: Say hello, your name is Xiaoming, and ask their name.
lines.hint: 你好！我叫|nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào
lines.say: 你好！我叫小明。你叫什么名字？|nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào Xiǎo Míng. nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
lines.en: Hello! My name is Xiaoming. What's your name?

lines.cue: Say hello and give your name (Anan).
lines.hint: 你好！我叫|nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào
lines.say: 你好！我叫安安。|nǐ hǎo! wǒ jiào Ān'an.
lines.en: Hello! My name is Anan.

lines.cue: Ask how old they are.
lines.say: 你几岁？|nǐ jǐ suì?
lines.en: How old are you?

lines.cue: Say you are eight, and ask them back.
lines.say: 我八岁。你呢？|wǒ bā suì. nǐ ne?
lines.en: I'm eight. And you?

lines.cue: Say you are nine. Ask where they're from.
lines.say: 我九岁。你是哪国人？|wǒ jiǔ suì. nǐ shì nǎ guó rén?
lines.en: I'm nine. Which country are you from?

lines.cue: Say you're English.
lines.say: 我是英国人。|wǒ shì Yīngguó rén.
lines.en: I'm English.

lines.cue: Say great! Let's play together!
lines.say: 太好了！我们一起玩吧！|tài hǎo le! wǒmen yìqǐ wán ba!
lines.en: Great! Let's play together!

lines.cue: Say OK!
lines.say: 好啊！|hǎo a!
lines.en: OK!

scenes.title: At the breakfast stall
scenes.setting: A street stall in Shanghai sells steamed buns and soy milk for breakfast.
scenes.tip: Use 两 (liǎng), not 二, before a measure word: 两个包子. 我要 (I want) is fine and normal in shops.

lines.cue: Say hello and ask what they want.
lines.hint: 你好！你要|nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào
lines.say: 你好！你要什么？|nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào shénme?
lines.en: Hello! What would you like?

lines.cue: Ask for two steamed buns.
lines.say: 我要两个包子。|wǒ yào liǎng ge bāozi.
lines.en: I'd like two steamed buns.

lines.cue: Say OK, and ask if they want anything else.
lines.hint: 好的。还要|hǎo de. hái yào
lines.say: 好的。还要别的吗？|hǎo de. hái yào bié de ma?
lines.en: OK. Anything else?

lines.cue: Say you'd also like a cup of soy milk.
lines.say: 我还要一杯豆浆。|wǒ hái yào yì bēi dòujiāng.
lines.en: I'd also like a cup of soy milk.

lines.cue: Ask if they're eating here or taking it away.
lines.say: 在这儿吃还是带走？|zài zhèr chī háishi dàizǒu?
lines.en: Eat here or take away?

lines.cue: Say take away, thanks. Ask how much it is.
lines.say: 带走，谢谢。多少钱？|dàizǒu, xièxie. duōshao qián?
lines.en: Take away, thanks. How much is it?

lines.cue: Say eight yuan altogether.
lines.say: 一共八块。|yígòng bā kuài.
lines.en: Eight yuan altogether.

lines.cue: Say here you are. Thank you, goodbye!
lines.say: 给你。谢谢！再见！|gěi nǐ. xièxie! zàijiàn!
lines.en: Here you are. Thank you! Goodbye!

lines.cue: Say you're welcome, take care!
lines.say: 不客气，慢走！|bú kèqi, màn zǒu!
lines.en: You're welcome, take care!

scenes.title: At the noodle restaurant
scenes.setting: You walk into a busy noodle restaurant with a friend.
scenes.tip: Waiters ask 几位？ (how many of you?). 服务员 (waiter) is how you call them over.

lines.cue: Say hello and ask how many people.
lines.say: 你好！几位？|nǐ hǎo! jǐ wèi?
lines.en: Hello! How many of you?

lines.cue: Say two.
lines.say: 两位。|liǎng wèi.
lines.en: Two.

lines.cue: Say please sit down, and ask what they'll drink.
lines.say: 请坐。你们喝什么？|qǐng zuò. nǐmen hē shénme?
lines.en: Please sit down. What will you drink?

lines.cue: Ask for a cup of tea, thanks.
lines.say: 我要一杯茶，谢谢。|wǒ yào yì bēi chá, xièxie.
lines.en: I'd like a cup of tea, thanks.

lines.cue: Ask what they'll eat.
lines.say: 吃什么？|chī shénme?
lines.en: What will you eat?

lines.cue: Ask for a bowl of noodles.
lines.hint: 我要一碗|wǒ yào yì wǎn
lines.say: 我要一碗面条。|wǒ yào yì wǎn miàntiáo.
lines.en: I'd like a bowl of noodles.

lines.cue: Say OK, coming right up.
lines.say: 好的，马上来。|hǎo de, mǎshàng lái.
lines.en: OK, coming right up.

lines.cue: Say excuse me, and ask where the toilet is.
lines.say: 请问，洗手间在哪儿？|qǐngwèn, xǐshǒujiān zài nǎr?
lines.en: Excuse me, where's the toilet?

lines.cue: Say it's over there, on the left.
lines.say: 在那儿，左边。|zài nàr, zuǒbian.
lines.en: Over there, on the left.

lines.cue: Say thanks. Call the waiter and ask for the bill.
lines.say: 谢谢！服务员，买单！|xièxie! fúwùyuán, mǎidān!
lines.en: Thanks! Waiter, the bill please!

scenes.title: Talking about pets
scenes.setting: You and a Chinese friend swap stories about your pets.
scenes.tip: 只 (zhī) is the measure word for animals: 一只狗, 一只猫. Describing words need 很: 它很小.

lines.cue: Ask if they have a pet.
lines.say: 你有宠物吗？|nǐ yǒu chǒngwù ma?
lines.en: Do you have a pet?

lines.cue: Say yes, you have a dog called Doudou.
lines.say: 有，我有一只狗。它叫豆豆。|yǒu, wǒ yǒu yì zhī gǒu. tā jiào Dòudou.
lines.en: Yes, I have a dog. It's called Doudou.

lines.cue: Ask what it's like.
lines.say: 它怎么样？|tā zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What's it like?

lines.cue: Say it's small and brown, and very cute. Ask them back.
lines.say: 它很小，是棕色的。非常可爱！你呢？|tā hěn xiǎo, shì zōngsè de. fēicháng kě'ài! nǐ ne?
lines.en: It's small and brown. Very cute! And you?

lines.cue: Say you have a black and white cat.
lines.hint: 我有一只|wǒ yǒu yì zhī
lines.say: 我有一只猫。它是黑白的。|wǒ yǒu yì zhī māo. tā shì hēibái de.
lines.en: I have a cat. It's black and white.

lines.cue: Ask if it's well-behaved.
lines.say: 它乖吗？|tā guāi ma?
lines.en: Is it well-behaved?

lines.cue: Say very, but it's a bit lazy!
lines.say: 很乖，可是有点儿懒！|hěn guāi, kěshì yǒudiǎnr lǎn!
lines.en: Very, but it's a bit lazy!

lines.cue: Say you really like cats!
lines.say: 我很喜欢猫！|wǒ hěn xǐhuan māo!
lines.en: I really like cats!

scenes.title: What do you like doing?
scenes.setting: You're making plans for the weekend with a Chinese friend.
scenes.tip: The verb shows how you play: 踢 (kick) football, 打 (hit) basketball, 弹 (pluck) piano.

lines.cue: Ask what they like doing.
lines.say: 你喜欢做什么？|nǐ xǐhuan zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you like doing?

lines.cue: Say you like playing football, and ask them back.
lines.say: 我喜欢踢足球。你呢？|wǒ xǐhuan tī zúqiú. nǐ ne?
lines.en: I like playing football. And you?

lines.cue: Say you prefer swimming. You also like reading.
lines.say: 我更喜欢游泳。我也喜欢看书。|wǒ gèng xǐhuan yóuyǒng. wǒ yě xǐhuan kàn shū.
lines.en: I prefer swimming. I also like reading.

lines.cue: Ask if they can play the piano.
lines.say: 你会弹钢琴吗？|nǐ huì tán gāngqín ma?
lines.en: Can you play the piano?

lines.cue: Say yes, you can. It's really fun!
lines.say: 会，我会弹钢琴。很好玩！|huì, wǒ huì tán gāngqín. hěn hǎowán!
lines.en: Yes, I can play the piano. It's really fun!

lines.cue: Say you can't play the piano, but you like singing.
lines.say: 我不会弹钢琴，可是我喜欢唱歌。|wǒ bú huì tán gāngqín, kěshì wǒ xǐhuan chàng gē.
lines.en: I can't play the piano, but I like singing.

lines.cue: Suggest going to the park on Saturday.
lines.say: 星期六我们去公园，好吗？|xīngqīliù wǒmen qù gōngyuán, hǎo ma?
lines.en: Shall we go to the park on Saturday?

lines.cue: Say good idea! See you Saturday!
lines.say: 好主意！星期六见！|hǎo zhǔyi! xīngqīliù jiàn!
lines.en: Good idea! See you Saturday!

scenes.title: In the clothes shop
scenes.setting: You want a new T-shirt from a shop in Beijing.
scenes.tip: 件 (jiàn) is the measure word for tops: 一件T恤, 这件 (this one).

lines.cue: Say hello and ask what they want to buy.
lines.hint: 你好！你要买|nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào mǎi
lines.say: 你好！你要买什么？|nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào mǎi shénme?
lines.en: Hello! What would you like to buy?

lines.cue: Say you'd like to buy a T-shirt.
lines.say: 我想买一件T恤。|wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí jiàn T xù.
lines.en: I'd like to buy a T-shirt.

lines.cue: Ask what colour they want.
lines.say: 你要什么颜色的？|nǐ yào shénme yánsè de?
lines.en: What colour would you like?

lines.cue: Say a blue one. You don't like red.
lines.say: 蓝色的。我不喜欢红色。|lánsè de. wǒ bù xǐhuan hóngsè.
lines.en: A blue one. I don't like red.

lines.cue: Ask what they think of this one.
lines.say: 这件怎么样？|zhè jiàn zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: How about this one?

lines.cue: Say it looks nice, but it's too big.
lines.say: 很好看，可是太大了。|hěn hǎokàn, kěshì tài dà le.
lines.en: It looks nice, but it's too big.

lines.cue: Say this one is a bit smaller.
lines.say: 这件小一点儿。|zhè jiàn xiǎo yìdiǎnr.
lines.en: This one is a bit smaller.

lines.cue: Say just right! Ask how much it is.
lines.say: 正好！多少钱？|zhènghǎo! duōshao qián?
lines.en: Just right! How much is it?

lines.cue: Say fifty yuan.
lines.say: 五十块。|wǔshí kuài.
lines.en: Fifty yuan.

lines.cue: Say you'll take this one. Thanks!
lines.hint: 我要这件。|wǒ yào zhè jiàn.
lines.say: 我要这件。谢谢！|wǒ yào zhè jiàn. xièxie!
lines.en: I'll take this one. Thanks!

scenes.title: Asking the way
scenes.setting: You're lost in a Chinese city and stop someone in the street.
scenes.tip: 请问 (excuse me, may I ask) opens any question to a stranger. Place words come after 在: 在银行旁边.

lines.cue: Say excuse me, and ask where the train station is.
lines.say: 请问，火车站在哪儿？|qǐngwèn, huǒchēzhàn zài nǎr?
lines.en: Excuse me, where is the train station?

lines.cue: Say go straight ahead, then turn left.
lines.hint: 一直往前走|yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu
lines.say: 一直往前走，然后往左拐。|yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu, ránhòu wǎng zuǒ guǎi.
lines.en: Go straight ahead, then turn left.

lines.cue: Ask if it's far.
lines.say: 远吗？|yuǎn ma?
lines.en: Is it far?

lines.cue: Say not far, five minutes on foot.
lines.say: 不远，走路五分钟。|bù yuǎn, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng.
lines.en: Not far, five minutes' walk.

lines.cue: Ask if there's a chemist near here.
lines.say: 这儿附近有药店吗？|zhèr fùjìn yǒu yàodiàn ma?
lines.en: Is there a chemist near here?

lines.cue: Say yes, next to the bank, opposite the park.
lines.say: 有，在银行旁边，公园对面。|yǒu, zài yínháng pángbiān, gōngyuán duìmiàn.
lines.en: Yes, next to the bank, opposite the park.

lines.cue: Say thank you very much!
lines.say: 非常感谢！|fēicháng gǎnxiè!
lines.en: Thank you very much!
alt: 太谢谢你了！|tài xièxie nǐ le!

lines.cue: Say you're welcome!
lines.say: 不客气！|bú kèqi!
lines.en: You're welcome!

scenes.title: Your weekend
scenes.setting: Monday morning. You and a friend talk about last weekend and the next one.
scenes.tip: 了 (le) shows it happened. 要 or 打算 + verb for plans. Add 因为 (because) to every opinion.

lines.cue: Ask what they did last weekend.
lines.hint: 你上个周末|nǐ shàng ge zhōumò
lines.say: 你上个周末做了什么？|nǐ shàng ge zhōumò zuò le shénme?
lines.en: What did you do last weekend?

lines.cue: Say on Saturday you went to see a film with friends.
lines.hint: 星期六我和朋友|xīngqīliù wǒ hé péngyou
lines.say: 星期六我和朋友去看电影了。|xīngqīliù wǒ hé péngyou qù kàn diànyǐng le.
lines.en: On Saturday I went to see a film with friends.

lines.cue: Ask what it was like.
lines.say: 怎么样？|zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What was it like?

lines.cue: Say it was great because the film was very funny. Ask them back.
lines.say: 很好看，因为电影很好笑。你呢？|hěn hǎokàn, yīnwèi diànyǐng hěn hǎoxiào. nǐ ne?
lines.en: It was great, because the film was very funny. And you?

lines.cue: Say you played football, and then ate pizza.
lines.hint: 我踢足球了|wǒ tī zúqiú le
lines.say: 我踢足球了，然后吃了比萨饼。|wǒ tī zúqiú le, ránhòu chī le bǐsàbǐng.
lines.en: I played football, then I ate pizza.

lines.cue: Ask what they plan to do next weekend.
lines.say: 下个周末你打算做什么？|xià ge zhōumò nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
lines.en: What are you planning to do next weekend?

lines.cue: Say you're going to visit your grandparents.
lines.hint: 我要去看|wǒ yào qù kàn
lines.say: 我要去看爷爷奶奶。|wǒ yào qù kàn yéye nǎinai.
lines.en: I'm going to visit my grandparents.

lines.cue: Ask if they prefer Saturday or Sunday, and why.
lines.say: 你更喜欢星期六还是星期天？为什么？|nǐ gèng xǐhuan xīngqīliù háishi xīngqītiān? wèishénme?
lines.en: Do you prefer Saturday or Sunday? Why?

lines.cue: Say you prefer Saturday because you can have a lie-in.
lines.hint: 我更喜欢星期六，因为|wǒ gèng xǐhuan xīngqīliù, yīnwèi
lines.say: 我更喜欢星期六，因为可以睡懒觉。|wǒ gèng xǐhuan xīngqīliù, yīnwèi kěyǐ shuì lǎnjiào.
lines.en: I prefer Saturday, because I can have a lie-in.

scenes.title: Talking about school
scenes.setting: Your Chinese exchange partner asks about your school. Exam-style: watch for the unexpected question.
scenes.tip: Listen for the time word: 昨天 (yesterday) means answer about the past, 明年 (next year) about the future.

lines.cue: Ask what their favourite subject is.
lines.say: 你最喜欢什么课？|nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme kè?
lines.en: What's your favourite subject?

lines.cue: Say history, because the teacher is really interesting.
lines.say: 我最喜欢历史课，因为老师很有意思。|wǒ zuì xǐhuan lìshǐ kè, yīnwèi lǎoshī hěn yǒu yìsi.
lines.en: My favourite is history, because the teacher is really interesting.

lines.cue: Ask if there's a subject they don't like.
lines.hint: 你有不喜欢的|nǐ yǒu bù xǐhuan de
lines.say: 你有不喜欢的课吗？|nǐ yǒu bù xǐhuan de kè ma?
lines.en: Is there a subject you don't like?

lines.cue: Say you don't like maths because it's too hard. Ask them back.
lines.say: 我不喜欢数学，因为太难了。你呢？|wǒ bù xǐhuan shùxué, yīnwèi tài nán le. nǐ ne?
lines.en: I don't like maths, because it's too hard. And you?

lines.cue: Say you really like science, but you don't like art.
lines.say: 我很喜欢科学，可是不喜欢美术。|wǒ hěn xǐhuan kēxué, kěshì bù xǐhuan měishù.
lines.en: I really like science, but I don't like art.

lines.cue: Ask what they did at school yesterday.
lines.say: 你昨天在学校做了什么？|nǐ zuótiān zài xuéxiào zuò le shénme?
lines.en: What did you do at school yesterday?

lines.cue: Say yesterday you had a Chinese test, and at lunchtime you played basketball.
lines.say: 昨天我有中文考试，午饭的时候我打篮球了。|zuótiān wǒ yǒu Zhōngwén kǎoshì, wǔfàn de shíhou wǒ dǎ lánqiú le.
lines.en: Yesterday I had a Chinese test, and at lunchtime I played basketball.

lines.cue: Ask what they want to study next year.
lines.say: 明年你想学什么？|míngnián nǐ xiǎng xué shénme?
lines.en: What do you want to study next year?

lines.cue: Say next year you want to study Spanish, because it's useful.
lines.hint: 明年我想学|míngnián wǒ xiǎng xué
lines.say: 明年我想学西班牙语，因为很有用。|míngnián wǒ xiǎng xué Xībānyáyǔ, yīnwèi hěn yǒuyòng.
lines.en: Next year I want to study Spanish, because it's useful.

scenes.title: At the hotel
scenes.setting: Your family arrives at a hotel in China. You do the talking. Exam-style: one unexpected question.
scenes.tip: 过 (guo) after a verb means "have ever done": 来过 (have been here). The polite "you" is 您 (nín).

lines.cue: Say good evening, and ask how you can help.
lines.say: 晚上好！有什么可以帮您？|wǎnshang hǎo! yǒu shénme kěyǐ bāng nín?
lines.en: Good evening! How can I help you?

lines.cue: Say you'd like a room for two nights.
lines.hint: 我想要一个房间|wǒ xiǎng yào yí ge fángjiān
lines.say: 晚上好！我想要一个房间，住两个晚上。|wǎnshang hǎo! wǒ xiǎng yào yí ge fángjiān, zhù liǎng ge wǎnshang.
lines.en: Good evening! I'd like a room for two nights.

lines.cue: Ask how many people.
lines.say: 几个人？|jǐ ge rén?
lines.en: How many people?

lines.cue: Say four: your mum and dad, your older brother and you.
lines.say: 四个人：我爸爸妈妈、我哥哥和我。|sì ge rén: wǒ bàba māma, wǒ gēge hé wǒ.
lines.en: Four: my mum and dad, my older brother and me.

lines.cue: Ask if they've been here before.
lines.say: 你们以前来过这儿吗？|nǐmen yǐqián lái guo zhèr ma?
lines.en: Have you been here before?

lines.cue: Say no, it's the first time. Last year you went to Spain.
lines.say: 没有，这是第一次。去年我们去了西班牙。|méiyǒu, zhè shì dì yī cì. qùnián wǒmen qù le Xībānyá.
lines.en: No, it's the first time. Last year we went to Spain.

lines.cue: Say OK. Ask if they have any questions.
lines.say: 好的。您有什么问题吗？|hǎo de. nín yǒu shénme wèntí ma?
lines.en: OK. Do you have any questions?

lines.cue: Ask what time breakfast is.
lines.say: 早饭几点？|zǎofàn jǐ diǎn?
lines.en: What time is breakfast?

lines.cue: Say from seven to ten in the morning.
lines.say: 早上七点到十点。|zǎoshang qī diǎn dào shí diǎn.
lines.en: From seven to ten in the morning.

lines.cue: Say great, thank you!
lines.say: 太好了，谢谢！|tài hǎo le, xièxie!
lines.en: Great, thank you!

scenes.title: At the fruit stall
scenes.setting: You're at a street market in Shanghai buying fruit for a picnic.
scenes.tip: 多少钱？ (how much?) works for anything. Prices are in 块 (kuài), the everyday word for yuan. 一斤 is half a kilo.

lines.cue: Say hello and ask what they'd like.
lines.hint: 你好！你要|nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào
lines.say: 你好！你要什么？|nǐ hǎo! nǐ yào shénme?
lines.en: Hello! What would you like?

lines.cue: Say you want apples. Ask how much a jin is.
lines.say: 我要苹果。一斤多少钱？|wǒ yào píngguǒ. yì jīn duōshao qián?
lines.en: I want apples. How much is a jin (half a kilo)?

lines.cue: Say eight kuai a jin.
lines.say: 八块一斤。|bā kuài yì jīn.
lines.en: Eight kuai a jin.

lines.cue: Say that's a bit expensive! Ask if it can be cheaper.
lines.say: 有点儿贵！便宜一点儿，好吗？|yǒudiǎnr guì! piányi yìdiǎnr, hǎo ma?
lines.en: That's a bit expensive! A bit cheaper, OK?
alt: 太贵了！能便宜一点儿吗？|tài guì le! néng piányi yìdiǎnr ma?

lines.cue: Say OK, seven kuai. Ask how many jin they want.
lines.hint: 好吧，七块。|hǎo ba, qī kuài.
lines.say: 好吧，七块。你要几斤？|hǎo ba, qī kuài. nǐ yào jǐ jīn?
lines.en: All right, seven kuai. How many jin do you want?

lines.cue: Say two jin. And one watermelon.
lines.say: 两斤。还要一个西瓜。|liǎng jīn. hái yào yí ge xīguā.
lines.en: Two jin. And I also want a watermelon.

lines.cue: Say the watermelon is ten kuai. Altogether twenty-four kuai.
lines.say: 西瓜十块。一共二十四块。|xīguā shí kuài. yígòng èrshísì kuài.
lines.en: The watermelon is ten kuai. Twenty-four kuai altogether.

lines.cue: Ask if you can pay with WeChat.
lines.say: 可以用微信吗？|kěyǐ yòng Wēixìn ma?
lines.en: Can I use WeChat (to pay)?

lines.cue: Say yes, scan here. Thank you!
lines.say: 可以，扫这里。谢谢！|kěyǐ, sǎo zhèlǐ. xièxie!
lines.en: Yes, scan here. Thank you!

scenes.title: At the bubble tea shop
scenes.setting: You and your friend stop at a bubble tea shop after school in Chengdu.
scenes.tip: 大杯 (large) and 中杯 (medium). 冰 is ice, 少冰 is less ice, 不要冰 is no ice. 要 does the ordering.

lines.cue: Say welcome! Ask what they'd like to drink.
lines.say: 欢迎光临！你想喝什么？|huānyíng guānglín! nǐ xiǎng hē shénme?
lines.en: Welcome! What would you like to drink?

lines.cue: Say you'd like a pearl milk tea.
lines.hint: 我要一杯|wǒ yào yì bēi
lines.say: 我要一杯珍珠奶茶。|wǒ yào yì bēi zhēnzhū nǎichá.
lines.en: I'd like a pearl milk tea.

lines.cue: Ask: large or medium?
lines.say: 大杯还是中杯？|dà bēi háishi zhōng bēi?
lines.en: Large or medium?

lines.cue: Say large, please.
lines.say: 大杯，谢谢。|dà bēi, xièxie.
lines.en: Large, please.

lines.cue: Ask if they want ice.
lines.say: 要冰吗？|yào bīng ma?
lines.en: Do you want ice?

lines.cue: Say less ice, and less sugar.
lines.say: 少冰，少糖。|shǎo bīng, shǎo táng.
lines.en: Less ice, less sugar.
alt: 不要冰，少糖。|bú yào bīng, shǎo táng.

lines.cue: Say fifteen kuai. Ask if they're drinking here or taking it away.
lines.say: 十五块。在这儿喝还是带走？|shíwǔ kuài. zài zhèr hē háishi dài zǒu?
lines.en: Fifteen kuai. Drinking here or taking away?

lines.cue: Say taking it away.
lines.say: 带走。|dài zǒu.
lines.en: Taking it away.

lines.cue: Say OK, please wait a moment.
lines.say: 好的，请等一下。|hǎo de, qǐng děng yíxià.
lines.en: OK, please wait a moment.

scenes.title: Taking a taxi
scenes.setting: You get in a taxi in Beijing and need to go to the Summer Palace.
scenes.tip: 我去… (I'm going to…) is all you need. 到了 means we've arrived. 师傅 (shīfu) is the polite way to address a driver.

lines.cue: Say hello! Ask where they're going.
lines.say: 你好！去哪儿？|nǐ hǎo! qù nǎr?
lines.en: Hello! Where to?

lines.cue: Say: driver, I'm going to the Summer Palace.
lines.say: 师傅，我去颐和园。|shīfu, wǒ qù Yíhéyuán.
lines.en: Driver, I'm going to the Summer Palace.

lines.cue: Say OK. Ask them to fasten their seatbelt.
lines.say: 好的。请系好安全带。|hǎo de. qǐng jì hǎo ānquándài.
lines.en: OK. Please fasten your seatbelt.

lines.cue: Ask if it's far.
lines.say: 远吗？|yuǎn ma?
lines.en: Is it far?

lines.cue: Say not very far, about twenty minutes.
lines.say: 不太远，大概二十分钟。|bú tài yuǎn, dàgài èrshí fēnzhōng.
lines.en: Not very far, about twenty minutes.

lines.cue: Ask if they're on holiday in Beijing.
lines.say: 你来北京旅游吗？|nǐ lái Běijīng lǚyóu ma?
lines.en: Are you in Beijing on holiday?

lines.cue: Say yes, Beijing is very fun!
lines.say: 对，北京很好玩！|duì, Běijīng hěn hǎowán!
lines.en: Yes, Beijing is great fun!

lines.cue: Say we've arrived. Thirty-five kuai.
lines.say: 到了。三十五块。|dào le. sānshíwǔ kuài.
lines.en: We're here. Thirty-five kuai.

lines.cue: Say here you are. Thank you, driver! Goodbye!
lines.say: 给你。谢谢师傅！再见！|gěi nǐ. xièxie shīfu! zàijiàn!
lines.en: Here you are. Thank you, driver! Goodbye!

scenes.title: At a birthday party
scenes.setting: Your Chinese friend has invited you to their birthday party at home.
scenes.tip: 生日快乐！ is happy birthday. 送给你 (this is for you) when you hand over a present. 好吃 (tasty) works for any food.

lines.cue: Say happy birthday!
lines.say: 生日快乐！|shēngrì kuàilè!
lines.en: Happy birthday!

lines.cue: Say thank you! Come in, please.
lines.say: 谢谢！请进！|xièxie! qǐng jìn!
lines.en: Thank you! Please come in!

lines.cue: Say this present is for you.
lines.say: 这是礼物，送给你。|zhè shì lǐwù, sòng gěi nǐ.
lines.en: This is a present for you.

lines.cue: Say wow, thank you! You're too kind.
lines.say: 哇，谢谢！你太客气了。|wā, xièxie! nǐ tài kèqi le.
lines.en: Wow, thank you! You're too kind.

lines.cue: Ask how old they are today.
lines.say: 你今天几岁？|nǐ jīntiān jǐ suì?
lines.en: How old are you today?

lines.cue: Say you're ten today. Ask if they want some cake.
lines.hint: 我今天十岁。|wǒ jīntiān shí suì.
lines.say: 我今天十岁。你要吃蛋糕吗？|wǒ jīntiān shí suì. nǐ yào chī dàngāo ma?
lines.en: I'm ten today. Do you want some cake?

lines.cue: Say yes please! Chocolate cake is your favourite.
lines.say: 要！我最喜欢巧克力蛋糕。|yào! wǒ zuì xǐhuan qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
lines.en: Yes! I love chocolate cake most.

lines.cue: Ask: is it tasty?
lines.say: 好吃吗？|hǎochī ma?
lines.en: Is it tasty?

lines.cue: Say very tasty! Let's sing a song together.
lines.say: 很好吃！我们一起唱歌吧！|hěn hǎochī! wǒmen yìqǐ chàng gē ba!
lines.en: Really tasty! Let's sing a song together!

scenes.title: My family and my home
scenes.setting: You're on a video call with your penfriend in Nanjing, talking about families and homes.
scenes.tip: Count people with 口: 我家有四口人. 有 (have) and 没有 (don't have): never 不有. 和 joins nouns (and), not sentences.

lines.cue: Ask how many people there are in their family.
lines.say: 你家有几口人？|nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
lines.en: How many people are there in your family?

lines.cue: Say four: dad, mum, an older brother and you.
lines.hint: 我家有四口人：|wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén:
lines.say: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。|wǒ jiā yǒu sì kǒu rén: bàba, māma, gēge hé wǒ.
lines.en: There are four people in my family: Dad, Mum, my older brother and me.

lines.cue: Ask what their brother is like.
lines.say: 你哥哥怎么样？|nǐ gēge zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What's your older brother like?

lines.cue: Say he's very tall and very funny, but a bit lazy.
lines.say: 他很高，也很有意思，但是有点儿懒。|tā hěn gāo, yě hěn yǒu yìsi, dànshì yǒudiǎnr lǎn.
lines.en: He's very tall and very funny, but a bit lazy.

lines.cue: Ask if they have brothers or sisters.
lines.say: 你有兄弟姐妹吗？|nǐ yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi ma?
lines.en: Do you have any brothers or sisters?

lines.cue: Say no, you're an only child. Ask where they live.
lines.say: 没有，我是独生子女。你住在哪儿？|méiyǒu, wǒ shì dúshēng zǐnǚ. nǐ zhù zài nǎr?
lines.en: No, I'm an only child. Where do you live?

lines.cue: Say you live in a house in a small town.
lines.say: 我住在一个小镇，我家是一座房子。|wǒ zhù zài yí ge xiǎo zhèn, wǒ jiā shì yí zuò fángzi.
lines.en: I live in a small town; my home is a house.

lines.cue: Ask what their bedroom is like.
lines.say: 你的房间怎么样？|nǐ de fángjiān zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What's your bedroom like?

lines.cue: Say it's not big, but very comfortable. There's a bed, a desk and lots of books.
lines.hint: 我的房间不大，|wǒ de fángjiān bú dà,
lines.say: 我的房间不大，但是很舒服。有一张床、一张书桌和很多书。|wǒ de fángjiān bú dà, dànshì hěn shūfu. yǒu yì zhāng chuáng, yì zhāng shūzhuō hé hěn duō shū.
lines.en: My room isn't big, but it's very comfortable. There's a bed, a desk and lots of books.

lines.cue: Say sounds great! Your home is a flat on the twentieth floor.
lines.say: 真不错！我家是公寓，在二十楼。|zhēn búcuò! wǒ jiā shì gōngyù, zài èrshí lóu.
lines.en: Sounds great! My home is a flat on the twentieth floor.

scenes.title: Dinner with a host family
scenes.setting: Your first evening with a host family in Xi'an. Dinner is on the table.
scenes.tip: 多吃一点儿！ (eat a bit more!) is what hosts say. 我吃饱了 means I'm full. 会 = can (a learned skill): 我会用筷子.

lines.cue: Say dinner's ready! Ask if they can use chopsticks.
lines.say: 吃饭了！你会用筷子吗？|chī fàn le! nǐ huì yòng kuàizi ma?
lines.en: Dinner's ready! Can you use chopsticks?

lines.cue: Say yes, a little, but not very well.
lines.say: 会一点儿，但是用得不太好。|huì yìdiǎnr, dànshì yòng de bú tài hǎo.
lines.en: A little, but not very well.

lines.cue: Say no problem. Ask if they like spicy food.
lines.say: 没关系。你喜欢吃辣的吗？|méi guānxi. nǐ xǐhuan chī là de ma?
lines.en: No problem. Do you like spicy food?

lines.cue: Say you like it a bit spicy, but not too spicy.
lines.say: 我喜欢有点儿辣，但是不要太辣。|wǒ xǐhuan yǒudiǎnr là, dànshì bú yào tài là.
lines.en: I like it a bit spicy, but not too spicy.

lines.cue: Say try this: dumplings with tomato and egg.
lines.say: 尝尝这个：西红柿鸡蛋饺子。|chángchang zhège: xīhóngshì jīdàn jiǎozi.
lines.en: Try this: tomato and egg dumplings.

lines.cue: Say it's delicious! You really like dumplings.
lines.say: 真好吃！我很喜欢吃饺子。|zhēn hǎochī! wǒ hěn xǐhuan chī jiǎozi.
lines.en: Delicious! I really like dumplings.

lines.cue: Ask if there's anything they don't eat.
lines.say: 你有什么不吃的吗？|nǐ yǒu shénme bù chī de ma?
lines.en: Is there anything you don't eat?

lines.cue: Say you don't eat mushrooms, sorry.
lines.say: 我不吃蘑菇，不好意思。|wǒ bù chī mógu, bù hǎoyìsi.
lines.en: I don't eat mushrooms, sorry.
alt: 我什么都吃！|wǒ shénme dōu chī!

lines.cue: Say that's fine. Eat a bit more!
lines.say: 没事。多吃一点儿！|méi shì. duō chī yìdiǎnr!
lines.en: That's fine. Eat a bit more!

lines.cue: Say thank you, you're full!
lines.say: 谢谢，我吃饱了！|xièxie, wǒ chī bǎo le!
lines.en: Thank you, I'm full!

scenes.title: At the doctor's
scenes.setting: You feel ill on a school trip in Hangzhou, so your teacher takes you to a clinic.
scenes.tip: Body part + 疼 says what hurts: 头疼 (headache), 肚子疼 (tummy ache). 从…开始 = since…. 要多喝水 (drink lots of water) is every Chinese doctor's advice.

lines.cue: Ask what's wrong.
lines.say: 你哪儿不舒服？|nǐ nǎr bù shūfu?
lines.en: What's wrong? (Where do you feel unwell?)

lines.cue: Say you've got a headache, and your throat hurts too.
lines.say: 我头疼，嗓子也疼。|wǒ tóu téng, sǎngzi yě téng.
lines.en: I've got a headache, and my throat hurts too.

lines.cue: Ask since when.
lines.say: 从什么时候开始的？|cóng shénme shíhou kāishǐ de?
lines.en: Since when?

lines.cue: Say since yesterday evening.
lines.say: 从昨天晚上开始的。|cóng zuótiān wǎnshang kāishǐ de.
lines.en: Since yesterday evening.

lines.cue: Ask if they have a temperature.
lines.say: 你发烧吗？|nǐ fāshāo ma?
lines.en: Do you have a temperature?

lines.cue: Say you don't know. You feel very hot and very tired.
lines.say: 我不知道。我觉得很热，也很累。|wǒ bù zhīdào. wǒ juéde hěn rè, yě hěn lèi.
lines.en: I don't know. I feel very hot and very tired.

lines.cue: Ask if they've eaten anything today.
lines.say: 你今天吃东西了吗？|nǐ jīntiān chī dōngxi le ma?
lines.en: Have you eaten anything today?

lines.cue: Say just a little rice porridge this morning.
lines.say: 早上吃了一点儿粥。|zǎoshang chī le yìdiǎnr zhōu.
lines.en: I had a little rice porridge this morning.

lines.cue: Say it's a cold. Take this medicine three times a day, and drink lots of water.
lines.say: 你感冒了。这个药一天吃三次，要多喝水。|nǐ gǎnmào le. zhège yào yì tiān chī sān cì, yào duō hē shuǐ.
lines.en: You've got a cold. Take this medicine three times a day, and drink lots of water.

lines.cue: Say OK, thank you, doctor!
lines.say: 好的，谢谢医生！|hǎo de, xièxie yīshēng!
lines.en: OK, thank you, doctor!

scenes.title: Weather and seasons
scenes.setting: You're chatting with a friend in Guangzhou about the weather here and at home.
scenes.tip: 天气怎么样？ asks about the weather. 下雨 (it rains), 下雪 (it snows). Compare with 比: 英国比广州冷.

lines.cue: Ask what the weather is like today.
lines.say: 今天天气怎么样？|jīntiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What's the weather like today?

lines.cue: Say it's very hot, thirty-two degrees!
lines.say: 今天很热，三十二度！|jīntiān hěn rè, sānshí'èr dù!
lines.en: It's very hot today, thirty-two degrees!

lines.cue: Ask what the weather is like in Britain.
lines.say: 英国的天气怎么样？|Yīngguó de tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What's the weather like in Britain?

lines.cue: Say it often rains, and it's colder than Guangzhou.
lines.say: 常常下雨，而且比广州冷。|chángcháng xià yǔ, érqiě bǐ Guǎngzhōu lěng.
lines.en: It often rains, and it's colder than Guangzhou.

lines.cue: Ask which season they like best.
lines.say: 你最喜欢哪个季节？|nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎge jìjié?
lines.en: Which season do you like best?

lines.cue: Say winter, because it snows and you can make a snowman.
lines.say: 冬天，因为会下雪，可以堆雪人。|dōngtiān, yīnwèi huì xià xuě, kěyǐ duī xuěrén.
lines.en: Winter, because it snows and you can make a snowman.
alt: 我最喜欢夏天，因为很暖和。|wǒ zuì xǐhuan xiàtiān, yīnwèi hěn nuǎnhuo.

lines.cue: Say it never snows in Guangzhou! You like spring best: not cold, not hot.
lines.say: 广州从来不下雪！我最喜欢春天，不冷也不热。|Guǎngzhōu cónglái bú xià xuě! wǒ zuì xǐhuan chūntiān, bù lěng yě bú rè.
lines.en: It never snows in Guangzhou! I like spring best: not cold and not hot.

lines.cue: Ask what the weather will be like tomorrow.
lines.say: 明天天气怎么样？|míngtiān tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What will the weather be like tomorrow?

lines.cue: Say the forecast says it will rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.
lines.say: 天气预报说明天会下雨，所以要带伞。|tiānqì yùbào shuō míngtiān huì xià yǔ, suǒyǐ yào dài sǎn.
lines.en: The forecast says it'll rain tomorrow, so take an umbrella.

scenes.title: Last summer holiday
scenes.setting: First day back at school. A classmate asks about your summer holiday.
scenes.tip: 了 after a verb says it happened: 我去了. 过 says you've ever done it: 你去过长城吗？ Time words come first: 七月我去了….

lines.cue: Ask where they went in the summer holiday.
lines.say: 暑假你去哪儿了？|shǔjià nǐ qù nǎr le?
lines.en: Where did you go in the summer holiday?

lines.cue: Say in July you went to Beijing with your family.
lines.say: 七月我和家人去了北京。|qīyuè wǒ hé jiārén qù le Běijīng.
lines.en: In July I went to Beijing with my family.

lines.cue: Ask how they got there.
lines.say: 你们怎么去的？|nǐmen zěnme qù de?
lines.en: How did you get there?

lines.cue: Say you went by plane; it took ten hours.
lines.say: 我们坐飞机去的，坐了十个小时。|wǒmen zuò fēijī qù de, zuò le shí ge xiǎoshí.
lines.en: We went by plane; it took ten hours.

lines.cue: Ask if they've ever been to the Great Wall.
lines.say: 你去过长城吗？|nǐ qù guo Chángchéng ma?
lines.en: Have you ever been to the Great Wall?

lines.cue: Say yes! You climbed the Great Wall, it was very tiring but very beautiful.
lines.say: 去过！我们爬了长城，很累，但是很漂亮。|qù guo! wǒmen pá le Chángchéng, hěn lèi, dànshì hěn piàoliang.
lines.en: Yes! We climbed the Great Wall. It was tiring but beautiful.

lines.cue: Ask what they ate.
lines.say: 你吃了什么？|nǐ chī le shénme?
lines.en: What did you eat?

lines.cue: Say you ate Peking duck. It was the best thing you've ever eaten!
lines.hint: 我吃了北京烤鸭。|wǒ chī le Běijīng kǎoyā.
lines.say: 我吃了北京烤鸭。那是我吃过的最好吃的东西！|wǒ chī le Běijīng kǎoyā. nà shì wǒ chī guo de zuì hǎochī de dōngxi!
lines.en: I ate Peking duck. It was the tastiest thing I've ever eaten!

lines.cue: Ask if they would like to go back again, and why.
lines.say: 你还想再去吗？为什么？|nǐ hái xiǎng zài qù ma? wèishénme?
lines.en: Would you like to go again? Why?

lines.cue: Say yes, because next time you want to see the pandas in Chengdu.
lines.say: 想，因为下次我想去成都看熊猫。|xiǎng, yīnwèi xià cì wǒ xiǎng qù Chéngdū kàn xióngmāo.
lines.en: Yes, because next time I want to go to Chengdu to see the pandas.

scenes.title: A healthy lifestyle
scenes.setting: You and a friend compare habits for a school project on healthy living.
scenes.tip: 每天 (every day) and 一个星期…次 (…times a week) say how often. 应该 (should) and 不应该 give advice. 对身体好 = good for your health.

lines.cue: Ask if they think they're healthy.
lines.say: 你觉得你健康吗？|nǐ juéde nǐ jiànkāng ma?
lines.en: Do you think you're healthy?

lines.cue: Say fairly healthy: you eat fruit every day, but you don't sleep enough.
lines.hint: 还可以。我每天|hái kěyǐ. wǒ měitiān
lines.say: 还可以。我每天吃水果，但是睡觉睡得不够。|hái kěyǐ. wǒ měitiān chī shuǐguǒ, dànshì shuìjiào shuì de bú gòu.
lines.en: Fairly healthy. I eat fruit every day, but I don't get enough sleep.

lines.cue: Ask how often they do exercise.
lines.say: 你多久运动一次？|nǐ duōjiǔ yùndòng yí cì?
lines.en: How often do you exercise?

lines.cue: Say three times a week: you swim and play basketball.
lines.hint: 一个星期三次。|yí ge xīngqī sān cì.
lines.say: 一个星期三次。我游泳，也打篮球。|yí ge xīngqī sān cì. wǒ yóuyǒng, yě dǎ lánqiú.
lines.en: Three times a week. I swim and I play basketball too.

lines.cue: Say you eat too many sweets and drink a lot of cola.
lines.hint: 我吃太多|wǒ chī tài duō
lines.say: 我吃太多糖，也喝很多可乐。|wǒ chī tài duō táng, yě hē hěn duō kělè.
lines.en: I eat too many sweets and drink a lot of cola.

lines.cue: Say you shouldn't drink so much cola because it's bad for your health.
lines.say: 你不应该喝那么多可乐，因为对身体不好。|nǐ bù yīnggāi hē nàme duō kělè, yīnwèi duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
lines.en: You shouldn't drink so much cola, because it's bad for your health.

lines.cue: Ask how much time they spend on their phone every day.
lines.say: 你每天玩手机玩多长时间？|nǐ měitiān wán shǒujī wán duō cháng shíjiān?
lines.en: How long do you spend on your phone each day?

lines.cue: Say about two hours. It's too long, so you go to bed late.
lines.hint: 大概两个小时。|dàgài liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
lines.say: 大概两个小时。太长了，所以我睡得很晚。|dàgài liǎng ge xiǎoshí. tài cháng le, suǒyǐ wǒ shuì de hěn wǎn.
lines.en: About two hours. It's too long, so I go to bed late.

lines.cue: Ask what they'll do to be healthier in future.
lines.say: 以后你会做什么让自己更健康？|yǐhòu nǐ huì zuò shénme ràng zìjǐ gèng jiànkāng?
lines.en: What will you do in future to be healthier?

lines.cue: Say from now on you'll put your phone away at nine and sleep earlier.
lines.say: 从现在开始，我九点以后不玩手机，早点儿睡觉。|cóng xiànzài kāishǐ, wǒ jiǔ diǎn yǐhòu bù wán shǒujī, zǎo diǎnr shuìjiào.
lines.en: From now on, no phone after nine, and I'll go to bed earlier.

scenes.title: Future plans and jobs
scenes.setting: Your Chinese teacher asks about your plans after school, as in a speaking exam.
scenes.tip: 想 (would like to), 打算 (plan to), 希望 (hope to). Give a reason with 因为…所以…. 当 = to work as: 我想当医生.

lines.cue: Ask what they want to do in the future.
lines.say: 你将来想做什么？|nǐ jiānglái xiǎng zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you want to do in the future?

lines.cue: Say you'd like to be a vet.
lines.say: 我想当兽医。|wǒ xiǎng dāng shòuyī.
lines.en: I'd like to be a vet.
alt: 我想当医生。|wǒ xiǎng dāng yīshēng.
我想当工程师。|wǒ xiǎng dāng gōngchéngshī.

lines.cue: Ask why.
lines.say: 为什么？|wèishénme?
lines.en: Why?

lines.cue: Say because you love animals, and you want to help them.
lines.hint: 因为我很喜欢|yīnwèi wǒ hěn xǐhuan
lines.say: 因为我很喜欢动物，而且我想帮助它们。|yīnwèi wǒ hěn xǐhuan dòngwù, érqiě wǒ xiǎng bāngzhù tāmen.
lines.en: Because I love animals, and I want to help them.

lines.cue: Ask what they plan to do after secondary school.
lines.hint: 中学毕业以后，|zhōngxué bìyè yǐhòu,
lines.say: 中学毕业以后，你打算做什么？|zhōngxué bìyè yǐhòu, nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you plan to do after secondary school?

lines.cue: Say you plan to go to university to study science.
lines.say: 我打算上大学，学习科学。|wǒ dǎsuàn shàng dàxué, xuéxí kēxué.
lines.en: I plan to go to university and study science.

lines.cue: Ask if they'd like to work abroad.
lines.hint: 你想在国外|nǐ xiǎng zài guówài
lines.say: 你想在国外工作吗？|nǐ xiǎng zài guówài gōngzuò ma?
lines.en: Would you like to work abroad?

lines.cue: Say yes, maybe in China, because then you could speak Chinese every day.
lines.say: 想，也许在中国，因为这样我可以每天说中文。|xiǎng, yěxǔ zài Zhōngguó, yīnwèi zhèyàng wǒ kěyǐ měitiān shuō Zhōngwén.
lines.en: Yes, maybe in China, because then I could speak Chinese every day.

lines.cue: Ask what's more important: money or an interesting job?
lines.hint: 钱和有意思的工作，|qián hé yǒu yìsi de gōngzuò,
lines.say: 钱和有意思的工作，哪个更重要？|qián hé yǒu yìsi de gōngzuò, nǎge gèng zhòngyào?
lines.en: Money or an interesting job: which is more important?

lines.cue: Say you think an interesting job is more important, because you'll do it every day.
lines.say: 我觉得有意思的工作更重要，因为每天都要做。|wǒ juéde yǒu yìsi de gōngzuò gèng zhòngyào, yīnwèi měitiān dōu yào zuò.
lines.en: I think an interesting job matters more, because you do it every day.

scenes.title: Lost bag at the station
scenes.setting: You've just got off the high-speed train in Shanghai and realise you left your bag on board.
scenes.tip: 丢了 = lost. Describe things with 是…的: 是蓝色的 (it's blue). 把 moves the object forward: 我把包忘在车上了.

lines.cue: Say excuse me, you've lost your bag. Ask if they can help you.
lines.hint: 不好意思，我的包|bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ de bāo
lines.say: 不好意思，我的包丢了。你能帮我吗？|bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ de bāo diū le. nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma?
lines.en: Excuse me, I've lost my bag. Can you help me?

lines.cue: Say of course. Ask where they lost it.
lines.say: 当然可以。你在哪儿丢的？|dāngrán kěyǐ. nǐ zài nǎr diū de?
lines.en: Of course. Where did you lose it?

lines.cue: Say you left it on the train, the one from Beijing.
lines.hint: 我把包忘在|wǒ bǎ bāo wàng zài
lines.say: 我把包忘在火车上了，从北京来的那趟。|wǒ bǎ bāo wàng zài huǒchē shang le, cóng Běijīng lái de nà tàng.
lines.en: I left my bag on the train, the one from Beijing.

lines.cue: Ask which carriage and which seat.
lines.say: 几号车厢？几号座位？|jǐ hào chēxiāng? jǐ hào zuòwèi?
lines.en: Which carriage? Which seat?

lines.cue: Say carriage five, seat 12A.
lines.say: 五号车厢，十二A。|wǔ hào chēxiāng, shí'èr A.
lines.en: Carriage five, seat 12A.

lines.cue: Ask what the bag looks like.
lines.say: 你的包是什么样子的？|nǐ de bāo shì shénme yàngzi de?
lines.en: What does your bag look like?

lines.cue: Say it's a small blue rucksack with a panda on it.
lines.hint: 是一个蓝色的|shì yí ge lánsè de
lines.say: 是一个蓝色的小背包，上面有一只熊猫。|shì yí ge lánsè de xiǎo bēibāo, shàngmian yǒu yì zhī xióngmāo.
lines.en: It's a small blue rucksack with a panda on it.

lines.cue: Ask what was inside it.
lines.say: 里面有什么？|lǐmian yǒu shénme?
lines.en: What was inside?

lines.cue: Say your passport, a book and a water bottle.
lines.hint: 有我的护照、|yǒu wǒ de hùzhào,
lines.say: 有我的护照、一本书和一个水瓶。|yǒu wǒ de hùzhào, yì běn shū hé yí ge shuǐpíng.
lines.en: My passport, a book and a water bottle.

lines.cue: Say don't worry: you'll phone the train now. Ask them to wait here.
lines.say: 别担心，我现在给火车打电话。请你在这儿等一下。|bié dānxīn, wǒ xiànzài gěi huǒchē dǎ diànhuà. qǐng nǐ zài zhèr děng yíxià.
lines.en: Don't worry, I'll phone the train now. Please wait here a moment.

scenes.title: At the zoo
scenes.setting: You and a friend are at the zoo in Chengdu, looking for the pandas.
scenes.tip: 在哪儿？ (where is it?) works for anything. 好可爱！ (so cute!) is the most useful word at a zoo.

lines.cue: Say you want to see the pandas.
lines.say: 我想看熊猫！|wǒ xiǎng kàn xióngmāo!
lines.en: I want to see the pandas!

lines.cue: Say me too! Ask where the pandas are.
lines.say: 我也是！熊猫在哪儿？|wǒ yě shì! xióngmāo zài nǎr?
lines.en: Me too! Where are the pandas?

lines.cue: Say they're over there, next to the monkeys.
lines.say: 在那儿，在猴子旁边。|zài nàr, zài hóuzi pángbiān.
lines.en: Over there, next to the monkeys.

lines.cue: Say look! There are three pandas!
lines.say: 你看！有三只熊猫！|nǐ kàn! yǒu sān zhī xióngmāo!
lines.en: Look! There are three pandas!

lines.cue: Say they're so cute! Ask what they're eating.
lines.say: 好可爱！它们在吃什么？|hǎo kě'ài! tāmen zài chī shénme?
lines.en: So cute! What are they eating?

lines.cue: Say they're eating bamboo.
lines.say: 它们在吃竹子。|tāmen zài chī zhúzi.
lines.en: They're eating bamboo.

lines.cue: Ask what their favourite animal is.
lines.say: 你最喜欢什么动物？|nǐ zuì xǐhuan shénme dòngwù?
lines.en: What's your favourite animal?

lines.cue: Say you like tigers best. Ask them back.
lines.say: 我最喜欢老虎。你呢？|wǒ zuì xǐhuan lǎohǔ. nǐ ne?
lines.en: I like tigers best. And you?

lines.cue: Say pandas, of course!
lines.say: 当然是熊猫！|dāngrán shì xióngmāo!
lines.en: Pandas, of course!

scenes.title: At the stationery shop
scenes.setting: You need things for school at a little stationery shop near the school gate.
scenes.tip: Measure words: 一支笔 (a pen), 一本本子 (a notebook), 一块橡皮 (a rubber). 一共 = altogether.

lines.cue: Say hello, ask what they want to buy.
lines.hint: 你好，你要|nǐ hǎo, nǐ yào
lines.say: 你好，你要买什么？|nǐ hǎo, nǐ yào mǎi shénme?
lines.en: Hello, what would you like to buy?

lines.cue: Say you want a pen and a notebook.
lines.hint: 我要一支笔|wǒ yào yì zhī bǐ
lines.say: 我要一支笔和一本本子。|wǒ yào yì zhī bǐ hé yì běn běnzi.
lines.en: I want a pen and a notebook.

lines.cue: Ask: what colour pen do you want?
lines.say: 你要什么颜色的笔？|nǐ yào shénme yánsè de bǐ?
lines.en: What colour pen do you want?

lines.cue: Say blue. Ask if they have rubbers.
lines.say: 蓝色的。有橡皮吗？|lánsè de. yǒu xiàngpí ma?
lines.en: Blue. Do you have rubbers?

lines.cue: Say yes, there are lots. This one is a little cat.
lines.say: 有，很多。这块是小猫。|yǒu, hěn duō. zhè kuài shì xiǎo māo.
lines.en: Yes, lots. This one is a little cat.

lines.cue: Say it's so cute, you want it. Ask how much altogether.
lines.hint: 好可爱，我要。|hǎo kě'ài, wǒ yào.
lines.say: 好可爱，我要。一共多少钱？|hǎo kě'ài, wǒ yào. yígòng duōshao qián?
lines.en: So cute, I'll have it. How much altogether?

lines.cue: Say twelve kuai altogether.
lines.say: 一共十二块。|yígòng shí'èr kuài.
lines.en: Twelve kuai altogether.

lines.cue: Say here you are (give the money).
lines.say: 给你。|gěi nǐ.
lines.en: Here you are.

lines.cue: Say thank you, goodbye!
lines.say: 谢谢，再见！|xièxie, zàijiàn!
lines.en: Thank you, goodbye!

scenes.title: What time shall we meet?
scenes.setting: You phone a friend to meet up on Saturday.
scenes.tip: Times: 两点 (two o'clock), 两点半 (half past two). Questions about time: 几点？ Days: 星期六 = Saturday.

lines.cue: Say hello, ask if they're free on Saturday.
lines.say: 喂，你星期六有空吗？|wèi, nǐ xīngqīliù yǒu kòng ma?
lines.en: Hello, are you free on Saturday?

lines.cue: Say yes. Ask what you're going to do.
lines.say: 有空。我们做什么？|yǒu kòng. wǒmen zuò shénme?
lines.en: Yes. What shall we do?

lines.cue: Say let's go to the cinema!
lines.say: 我们去看电影吧！|wǒmen qù kàn diànyǐng ba!
lines.en: Let's go and see a film!

lines.cue: Say good! Ask what time.
lines.say: 好啊！几点？|hǎo a! jǐ diǎn?
lines.en: Great! What time?

lines.cue: Say at two o'clock.
lines.say: 两点，好吗？|liǎng diǎn, hǎo ma?
lines.en: Two o'clock, OK?

lines.cue: Say two is too early. Suggest half past two.
lines.hint: 两点太早了。|liǎng diǎn tài zǎo le.
lines.say: 两点太早了。两点半吧。|liǎng diǎn tài zǎo le. liǎng diǎn bàn ba.
lines.en: Two is too early. Let's say half past two.

lines.cue: Say OK. Ask where to meet.
lines.hint: 好的。我们在哪儿|hǎo de. wǒmen zài nǎr
lines.say: 好的。我们在哪儿见？|hǎo de. wǒmen zài nǎr jiàn?
lines.en: OK. Where shall we meet?

lines.cue: Say at the cinema door.
lines.say: 在电影院门口。|zài diànyǐngyuàn ménkǒu.
lines.en: At the cinema entrance.

lines.cue: Say great, see you Saturday!
lines.say: 太好了，星期六见！|tài hǎo le, xīngqīliù jiàn!
lines.en: Great, see you on Saturday!

scenes.title: At the park
scenes.setting: You're at a park in Shanghai and want to join a game of football.
scenes.tip: 可以…吗？ asks permission: 我可以玩吗？ (can I play?). 一起 = together.

lines.cue: Say hello. Ask what they're playing.
lines.hint: 你好！你们在|nǐ hǎo! nǐmen zài
lines.say: 你好！你们在玩什么？|nǐ hǎo! nǐmen zài wán shénme?
lines.en: Hello! What are you playing?

lines.cue: Say you're playing football.
lines.say: 我们在踢足球。|wǒmen zài tī zúqiú.
lines.en: We're playing football.

lines.cue: Ask if you can play too.
lines.say: 我可以一起玩吗？|wǒ kěyǐ yìqǐ wán ma?
lines.en: Can I play too?

lines.cue: Say of course! Ask if they can play well.
lines.say: 当然可以！你踢得好吗？|dāngrán kěyǐ! nǐ tī de hǎo ma?
lines.en: Of course! Are you good?

lines.cue: Say just OK.
lines.say: 还可以。|hái kěyǐ.
lines.en: I'm OK.

lines.cue: Say you're on our team. Stand over there.
lines.hint: 你在我们队。|nǐ zài wǒmen duì.
lines.say: 你在我们队。你站那儿。|nǐ zài wǒmen duì. nǐ zhàn nàr.
lines.en: You're on our team. Stand over there.

lines.cue: Say OK! Pass the ball to me!
lines.say: 好！传给我！|hǎo! chuán gěi wǒ!
lines.en: OK! Pass it to me!

lines.cue: Say goal! You're great!
lines.say: 进了！你真棒！|jìn le! nǐ zhēn bàng!
lines.en: Goal! You're brilliant!

lines.cue: Say thanks! Let's play again tomorrow.
lines.say: 谢谢！我们明天再玩吧！|xièxie! wǒmen míngtiān zài wán ba!
lines.en: Thanks! Let's play again tomorrow!

scenes.title: My daily routine
scenes.setting: A video call with your penfriend in Beijing, comparing your school days.
scenes.tip: Time goes before the verb: 我七点起床 (I get up at seven). 然后 = then, 以后 = after.

lines.cue: Ask what time they get up every day.
lines.hint: 你每天几点|nǐ měitiān jǐ diǎn
lines.say: 你每天几点起床？|nǐ měitiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?
lines.en: What time do you get up every day?

lines.cue: Say you get up at seven, then eat breakfast.
lines.hint: 我七点起床，|wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng,
lines.say: 我七点起床，然后吃早饭。|wǒ qī diǎn qǐchuáng, ránhòu chī zǎofàn.
lines.en: I get up at seven, then I have breakfast.

lines.cue: Ask what they eat for breakfast.
lines.say: 你早饭吃什么？|nǐ zǎofàn chī shénme?
lines.en: What do you have for breakfast?

lines.cue: Say usually cereal and milk. Ask them back.
lines.say: 一般吃麦片，喝牛奶。你呢？|yìbān chī màipiàn, hē niúnǎi. nǐ ne?
lines.en: Usually cereal and milk. And you?

lines.cue: Say you eat buns and soy milk. School starts at half past seven.
lines.say: 我吃包子，喝豆浆。七点半上课。|wǒ chī bāozi, hē dòujiāng. qī diǎn bàn shàngkè.
lines.en: I have buns and soy milk. School starts at half seven.

lines.cue: Say wow, so early! Your school starts at nine.
lines.say: 哇，这么早！我们九点上课。|wā, zhème zǎo! wǒmen jiǔ diǎn shàngkè.
lines.en: Wow, so early! We start at nine.

lines.cue: Ask what they do after school.
lines.say: 放学以后你做什么？|fàngxué yǐhòu nǐ zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you do after school?

lines.cue: Say first you do homework, then play on your phone a bit.
lines.hint: 我先做作业，|wǒ xiān zuò zuòyè,
lines.say: 我先做作业，然后玩一会儿手机。|wǒ xiān zuò zuòyè, ránhòu wán yíhuìr shǒujī.
lines.en: First I do my homework, then I go on my phone for a bit.

lines.cue: Ask what time they go to bed.
lines.say: 你几点睡觉？|nǐ jǐ diǎn shuìjiào?
lines.en: What time do you go to bed?

lines.cue: Say about half past nine.
lines.say: 大概九点半。|dàgài jiǔ diǎn bàn.
lines.en: About half past nine.

scenes.title: My town
scenes.setting: A new friend in Hangzhou asks about where you live.
scenes.tip: 有 lists what's there: 我的城市有一个公园. 没有 = there isn't. Add 很 or 非常 before adjectives.

lines.cue: Ask where they live.
lines.say: 你住在哪儿？|nǐ zhù zài nǎr?
lines.en: Where do you live?

lines.cue: Say you live in a small town in England.
lines.say: 我住在英国的一个小城市。|wǒ zhù zài Yīngguó de yí ge xiǎo chéngshì.
lines.en: I live in a small town in England.

lines.cue: Ask what there is in their town.
lines.hint: 你的城市有|nǐ de chéngshì yǒu
lines.say: 你的城市有什么？|nǐ de chéngshì yǒu shénme?
lines.en: What is there in your town?

lines.cue: Say there's a big park, a library and a lot of shops.
lines.hint: 有一个大公园，|yǒu yí ge dà gōngyuán,
lines.say: 有一个大公园、一个图书馆和很多商店。|yǒu yí ge dà gōngyuán, yí ge túshūguǎn hé hěn duō shāngdiàn.
lines.en: There's a big park, a library and lots of shops.

lines.cue: Ask if there's a cinema.
lines.say: 有没有电影院？|yǒu méiyǒu diànyǐngyuàn?
lines.en: Is there a cinema?

lines.cue: Say no, there isn't a cinema, which is a bit boring.
lines.say: 没有电影院，有点儿无聊。|méiyǒu diànyǐngyuàn, yǒudiǎnr wúliáo.
lines.en: There isn't a cinema, which is a bit boring.

lines.cue: Ask if they like their town.
lines.say: 你喜欢你的城市吗？|nǐ xǐhuan nǐ de chéngshì ma?
lines.en: Do you like your town?

lines.cue: Say yes, because it's very quiet and clean.
lines.say: 喜欢，因为很安静，也很干净。|xǐhuan, yīnwèi hěn ānjìng, yě hěn gānjìng.
lines.en: Yes, because it's very quiet and clean too.

lines.cue: Say Hangzhou is very big and has a beautiful lake.
lines.say: 杭州很大，有一个很漂亮的湖。|Hángzhōu hěn dà, yǒu yí ge hěn piàoliang de hú.
lines.en: Hangzhou is very big and has a beautiful lake.

scenes.title: Chinese New Year
scenes.setting: You're visiting a friend's family in Xi'an at Chinese New Year.
scenes.tip: 新年快乐！ (Happy New Year!) and 恭喜发财！ are the greetings. Take a red envelope with both hands and say 谢谢.

lines.cue: Say Happy New Year, Grandma!
lines.say: 奶奶，新年快乐！|nǎinai, xīnnián kuàilè!
lines.en: Happy New Year, Grandma!

lines.cue: Say Happy New Year! This red envelope is for you.
lines.say: 新年快乐！这个红包给你。|xīnnián kuàilè! zhège hóngbāo gěi nǐ.
lines.en: Happy New Year! This red envelope is for you.

lines.cue: Say thank you, Grandma!
lines.say: 谢谢奶奶！|xièxie nǎinai!
lines.en: Thank you, Grandma!

lines.cue: Ask if they've eaten dumplings before.
lines.say: 你吃过饺子吗？|nǐ chīguo jiǎozi ma?
lines.en: Have you ever eaten dumplings?

lines.cue: Say yes, you love dumplings, but you've never made them.
lines.hint: 吃过，我很喜欢。|chīguo, wǒ hěn xǐhuan.
lines.say: 吃过，我很喜欢。但是我没包过。|chīguo, wǒ hěn xǐhuan. dànshì wǒ méi bāoguo.
lines.en: Yes, I love them. But I've never made them.

lines.cue: Say come, let's make them together. Look, like this.
lines.say: 来，我们一起包。你看，这样。|lái, wǒmen yìqǐ bāo. nǐ kàn, zhèyàng.
lines.en: Come, let's make them together. Look, like this.

lines.cue: Ask: like this? Is that right?
lines.say: 这样吗？对不对？|zhèyàng ma? duì bu duì?
lines.en: Like this? Is that right?

lines.cue: Say very good! Ask what people do at New Year in England.
lines.hint: 很好！在英国，|hěn hǎo! zài Yīngguó,
lines.say: 很好！在英国，新年做什么？|hěn hǎo! zài Yīngguó, xīnnián zuò shénme?
lines.en: Very good! What do people do at New Year in England?

lines.cue: Say we watch fireworks and stay up until twelve.
lines.say: 我们看烟花，一直玩到十二点。|wǒmen kàn yānhuā, yìzhí wán dào shí'èr diǎn.
lines.en: We watch fireworks and stay up until midnight.

lines.cue: Say we watch fireworks too! Let's eat!
lines.say: 我们也看烟花！来，吃饺子吧！|wǒmen yě kàn yānhuā! lái, chī jiǎozi ba!
lines.en: We watch fireworks too! Come on, let's eat dumplings!

scenes.title: Describing a friend
scenes.setting: You show a friend a photo of your best friend back home.
scenes.tip: Describe people with 很 + adjective: 很高, 很有意思. Hair: 她是长头发 / 短头发 (long / short hair). 戴眼镜 = wears glasses.

lines.cue: Ask who this is in the photo.
lines.say: 照片里这个人是谁？|zhàopiàn lǐ zhège rén shì shéi?
lines.en: Who's this in the photo?

lines.cue: Say she's your best friend. Her name is Lily.
lines.hint: 她是我最好的|tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de
lines.say: 她是我最好的朋友，叫莉莉。|tā shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyou, jiào Lìli.
lines.en: She's my best friend. Her name is Lily.

lines.cue: Say she's very tall! Ask how old she is.
lines.say: 她很高！她多大？|tā hěn gāo! tā duō dà?
lines.en: She's very tall! How old is she?

lines.cue: Say she's eleven, the same as you.
lines.say: 她十一岁，跟我一样大。|tā shíyī suì, gēn wǒ yíyàng dà.
lines.en: She's eleven, the same age as me.

lines.cue: Ask what she's like.
lines.say: 她怎么样？|tā zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: What's she like?

lines.cue: Say she's very funny and kind, but a bit lazy!
lines.hint: 她很有意思，|tā hěn yǒu yìsi,
lines.say: 她很有意思，也很友好，但是有点儿懒！|tā hěn yǒu yìsi, yě hěn yǒuhǎo, dànshì yǒudiǎnr lǎn!
lines.en: She's really funny and friendly, but a bit lazy!

lines.cue: Ask what you like doing together.
lines.say: 你们喜欢一起做什么？|nǐmen xǐhuan yìqǐ zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you like doing together?

lines.cue: Say you like drawing and watching films together.
lines.hint: 我们喜欢一起|wǒmen xǐhuan yìqǐ
lines.say: 我们喜欢一起画画儿，看电影。|wǒmen xǐhuan yìqǐ huà huàr, kàn diànyǐng.
lines.en: We like drawing and watching films together.

lines.cue: Say she sounds great. You'd like to meet her.
lines.say: 她真好。我想认识她！|tā zhēn hǎo. wǒ xiǎng rènshi tā!
lines.en: She sounds great. I'd like to meet her!

scenes.title: Technology and phones
scenes.setting: You and a friend in Shenzhen talk about phones and screen time.
scenes.tip: 因为…所以… gives reason and result. 一方面…另一方面… (on one hand… on the other) wins marks for balance.

lines.cue: Ask if they have a phone.
lines.say: 你有手机吗？|nǐ yǒu shǒujī ma?
lines.en: Do you have a phone?

lines.cue: Say yes, your parents bought it for you last year.
lines.say: 有，是我爸妈去年给我买的。|yǒu, shì wǒ bà mā qùnián gěi wǒ mǎi de.
lines.en: Yes, my parents bought it for me last year.

lines.cue: Ask what they usually use it for.
lines.hint: 你一般用手机|nǐ yìbān yòng shǒujī
lines.say: 你一般用手机做什么？|nǐ yìbān yòng shǒujī zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you usually use your phone for?

lines.cue: Say you chat with friends, listen to music and sometimes look things up for homework.
lines.hint: 我跟朋友聊天，|wǒ gēn péngyou liáotiān,
lines.say: 我跟朋友聊天，听音乐，有时候查作业。|wǒ gēn péngyou liáotiān, tīng yīnyuè, yǒu shíhou chá zuòyè.
lines.en: I chat with friends, listen to music and sometimes look things up for homework.

lines.cue: Ask if they think phones are good for young people.
lines.hint: 你觉得手机对年轻人|nǐ juéde shǒujī duì niánqīngrén
lines.say: 你觉得手机对年轻人好吗？|nǐ juéde shǒujī duì niánqīngrén hǎo ma?
lines.en: Do you think phones are good for young people?

lines.cue: Say on one hand they're very useful; on the other hand, using them too much is bad for your eyes.
lines.hint: 一方面很有用，|yì fāngmiàn hěn yǒuyòng,
lines.say: 一方面很有用，另一方面用得太多对眼睛不好。|yì fāngmiàn hěn yǒuyòng, lìng yì fāngmiàn yòng de tài duō duì yǎnjing bù hǎo.
lines.en: On one hand they're very useful; on the other, using them too much is bad for your eyes.

lines.cue: Ask how long they used their phone yesterday.
lines.hint: 你昨天用了|nǐ zuótiān yòng le
lines.say: 你昨天用了多长时间手机？|nǐ zuótiān yòng le duō cháng shíjiān shǒujī?
lines.en: How long did you use your phone yesterday?

lines.cue: Say three hours, because you played a game, so you went to bed late.
lines.hint: 三个小时。因为|sān ge xiǎoshí. yīnwèi
lines.say: 三个小时。因为我玩了游戏，所以睡得很晚。|sān ge xiǎoshí. yīnwèi wǒ wán le yóuxì, suǒyǐ shuì de hěn wǎn.
lines.en: Three hours. Because I played a game, I went to bed late.

lines.cue: Ask if they'll use it less in future.
lines.say: 以后你会少用一点儿吗？|yǐhòu nǐ huì shǎo yòng yìdiǎnr ma?
lines.en: Will you use it less in future?

lines.cue: Say yes, from next week you'll put your phone outside your bedroom.
lines.hint: 会。从下个星期开始，|huì. cóng xià ge xīngqī kāishǐ,
lines.say: 会。从下个星期开始，我会把手机放在卧室外面。|huì. cóng xià ge xīngqī kāishǐ, wǒ huì bǎ shǒujī fàng zài wòshì wàimiàn.
lines.en: Yes. From next week, I'll leave my phone outside my bedroom.

scenes.title: Protecting the environment
scenes.setting: You and a classmate in Beijing are planning a class talk about the environment.
scenes.tip: 应该 = should, 不应该 = shouldn't. 为了 + goal (in order to). Recycling is 回收 or 垃圾分类 (sorting rubbish).

lines.cue: Ask what the biggest environmental problem is, in their opinion.
lines.hint: 你觉得最大的|nǐ juéde zuì dà de
lines.say: 你觉得最大的环境问题是什么？|nǐ juéde zuì dà de huánjìng wèntí shì shénme?
lines.en: What do you think is the biggest environmental problem?

lines.cue: Say pollution, because there are too many cars in cities.
lines.say: 是污染，因为城市里汽车太多了。|shì wūrǎn, yīnwèi chéngshì lǐ qìchē tài duō le.
lines.en: Pollution, because there are too many cars in cities.

lines.cue: Ask what they do to protect the environment.
lines.hint: 你为了保护环境|nǐ wèile bǎohù huánjìng
lines.say: 你为了保护环境做什么？|nǐ wèile bǎohù huánjìng zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you do to protect the environment?

lines.cue: Say you walk to school and you sort the rubbish at home.
lines.say: 我走路上学，在家也做垃圾分类。|wǒ zǒulù shàngxué, zài jiā yě zuò lājī fēnlèi.
lines.en: I walk to school, and I sort the rubbish at home too.

lines.cue: Say last week you bought a lot of things in plastic bags.
lines.hint: 上个星期我|shàng ge xīngqī wǒ
lines.say: 上个星期我买了很多东西，用了很多塑料袋。|shàng ge xīngqī wǒ mǎi le hěn duō dōngxi, yòng le hěn duō sùliàodài.
lines.en: Last week I bought lots of things and used lots of plastic bags.

lines.cue: Say we shouldn't use plastic bags; we should bring our own bag.
lines.say: 我们不应该用塑料袋，应该带自己的包。|wǒmen bù yīnggāi yòng sùliàodài, yīnggāi dài zìjǐ de bāo.
lines.en: We shouldn't use plastic bags; we should bring our own bag.

lines.cue: Ask what the school could do.
lines.say: 学校可以做什么？|xuéxiào kěyǐ zuò shénme?
lines.en: What could the school do?

lines.cue: Say the school could plant more trees and turn the lights off after class.
lines.hint: 学校可以多种树，|xuéxiào kěyǐ duō zhòng shù,
lines.say: 学校可以多种树，下课以后关灯。|xuéxiào kěyǐ duō zhòng shù, xiàkè yǐhòu guān dēng.
lines.en: The school could plant more trees and turn off the lights after lessons.

lines.cue: Say good idea! Let's put that in our talk.
lines.say: 好主意！我们把这个写进演讲里吧。|hǎo zhǔyi! wǒmen bǎ zhège xiě jìn yǎnjiǎng lǐ ba.
lines.en: Good idea! Let's put that in our talk.

scenes.title: Last week's school trip
scenes.setting: You tell a friend in Nanjing about your class trip to the science museum.
scenes.tip: Past: 去了, 看了. Experience: 去过. Comparisons: A 比 B + adjective (博物馆比公园有意思).

lines.cue: Ask where they went on the school trip last week.
lines.hint: 上个星期你们|shàng ge xīngqī nǐmen
lines.say: 上个星期你们去哪儿了？|shàng ge xīngqī nǐmen qù nǎr le?
lines.en: Where did you go last week?

lines.cue: Say your class went to the science museum.
lines.hint: 我们班去了|wǒmen bān qù le
lines.say: 我们班去了科技馆。|wǒmen bān qù le kējìguǎn.
lines.en: Our class went to the science museum.

lines.cue: Ask how they got there.
lines.say: 你们怎么去的？|nǐmen zěnme qù de?
lines.en: How did you get there?

lines.cue: Say by coach; it took an hour.
lines.hint: 坐大巴去的，|zuò dàbā qù de,
lines.say: 坐大巴去的，坐了一个小时。|zuò dàbā qù de, zuò le yí ge xiǎoshí.
lines.en: By coach; it took an hour.

lines.cue: Ask what they saw.
lines.say: 你们看了什么？|nǐmen kàn le shénme?
lines.en: What did you see?

lines.cue: Say you saw robots and a space exhibition, and you made a little rocket.
lines.hint: 我们看了机器人|wǒmen kàn le jīqìrén
lines.say: 我们看了机器人和太空展览，还做了一个小火箭。|wǒmen kàn le jīqìrén hé tàikōng zhǎnlǎn, hái zuò le yí ge xiǎo huǒjiàn.
lines.en: We saw robots and a space exhibition, and we made a little rocket.

lines.cue: Ask if it was better than last year's trip to the park.
lines.say: 比去年去公园好吗？|bǐ qùnián qù gōngyuán hǎo ma?
lines.en: Was it better than last year's trip to the park?

lines.cue: Say yes, the museum was much more interesting than the park, because you could touch everything.
lines.hint: 好多了！科技馆比公园|hǎo duō le! kējìguǎn bǐ gōngyuán
lines.say: 好多了！科技馆比公园有意思多了，因为什么都可以摸。|hǎo duō le! kējìguǎn bǐ gōngyuán yǒu yìsi duō le, yīnwèi shénme dōu kěyǐ mō.
lines.en: Much better! The museum was far more interesting than the park, because you could touch everything.

lines.cue: Ask if they've ever been to a museum in China.
lines.say: 你去过中国的博物馆吗？|nǐ qùguo Zhōngguó de bówùguǎn ma?
lines.en: Have you ever been to a museum in China?

lines.cue: Say not yet, but you'd like to go to the one in Xi'an next year.
lines.say: 还没有，但是明年我想去西安的博物馆。|hái méiyǒu, dànshì míngnián wǒ xiǎng qù Xī'ān de bówùguǎn.
lines.en: Not yet, but next year I'd like to go to the museum in Xi'an.

scenes.title: A trip to the Great Wall
scenes.setting: Back at your host family's flat after a day at the Great Wall near Beijing.
scenes.tip: Past with 了, experience with 过, future with 要/会/打算. 虽然…但是… (although… but…) adds a level.

lines.cue: Ask if they had a good time at the Great Wall today.
lines.say: 今天在长城玩得怎么样？|jīntiān zài Chángchéng wán de zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: How was your day at the Great Wall?

lines.cue: Say it was amazing! You'd never been before.
lines.say: 太棒了！我以前没去过。|tài bàng le! wǒ yǐqián méi qùguo.
lines.en: Amazing! I'd never been before.

lines.cue: Ask how they went up.
lines.say: 你们是怎么上去的？|nǐmen shì zěnme shàngqu de?
lines.en: How did you get up?

lines.cue: Say you walked up, and came down by toboggan.
lines.say: 我们走上去，坐滑道下来的。|wǒmen zǒu shàngqu, zuò huádào xiàlai de.
lines.en: We walked up and came down on the toboggan.

lines.cue: Ask if they were tired.
lines.say: 你累不累？|nǐ lèi bu lèi?
lines.en: Were you tired?

lines.cue: Say although it was very tiring, the view was very beautiful.
lines.say: 虽然很累，但是风景非常漂亮。|suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì fēngjǐng fēicháng piàoliang.
lines.en: Although it was very tiring, the view was beautiful.

lines.cue: Ask what they bought.
lines.say: 你买了什么东西？|nǐ mǎi le shénme dōngxi?
lines.en: What did you buy?

lines.cue: Say a T-shirt that says 'I climbed the Great Wall'.
lines.hint: 我买了一件T恤，|wǒ mǎi le yí jiàn T xù,
lines.say: 我买了一件T恤，上面写着“我登上了长城”。|wǒ mǎi le yí jiàn T xù, shàngmiàn xiězhe “wǒ dēngshàng le Chángchéng”.
lines.en: I bought a T-shirt that says 'I climbed the Great Wall'.

lines.cue: Ask what they're going to do tomorrow.
lines.say: 明天你打算做什么？|míngtiān nǐ dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
lines.en: What are you planning to do tomorrow?

lines.cue: Say tomorrow you're going to the Forbidden City, and in the evening you'll eat Peking duck.
lines.hint: 明天我要去故宫，|míngtiān wǒ yào qù Gùgōng,
lines.say: 明天我要去故宫，晚上去吃北京烤鸭。|míngtiān wǒ yào qù Gùgōng, wǎnshang qù chī Běijīng kǎoyā.
lines.en: Tomorrow I'm going to the Forbidden City, and in the evening I'll have Peking duck.
